steps.title: Prepare CSV and parameters
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file with the required headers (including Source Labware, Destination Well, Volume, Aspiration Height, Slot, etc.) using the format shown in the example, and upload it to the protocol. Select the pipette model, specify the pipette mount (left or right), choose the tip type (filter or non‑filter), and set the tip‑usage strategy (new tip for each transfer or reuse the same tip).

substeps.instruction: Create CSV with required columns and headers
Upload CSV to the protocol interface
Set tip usage strategy (new tip per transfer or reuse)

steps.title: Load pipette and tips
steps.instruction: Mount the selected single‑channel pipette on the specified mount, attach the chosen tip type, and place the tip rack in its designated slot.

steps.title: Transfer sample for each CSV line
steps.instruction: For each row in the uploaded CSV, aspirate the user‑specified volume from the source well in the designated labware slot at the defined aspiration height from the bottom of the well, then dispense that volume into the corresponding destination well of the final PCR plate located in slot 11, following the selected tip‑usage strategy.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate volume at specified height from source well
Dispense volume into destination well in PCR plate (slot 11)

steps.title: Add primer to destination wells
steps.instruction: Aspirate the user‑specified volume of primer and dispense it into each destination well of the final PCR plate (slot 11), using the same pipette settings as above.
